grok.pulse: Nasdaq and S&P closed sharply higher Monday (+2.7% and +2.3%) as oil plunged 4-5% on Trump's comments that renewed Iran strikes are highly unlikely if talks progress, easing inflation fears and sparking broad dip-buying after last week's AI selloff, though Nvidia fell on its CEO probe.
grok.bias: risk-on — oil collapse and Iran de-escalation hopes reduced inflation and geopolitical risk, fueling equity rebound including AI/chips ex-NVDA ahead of CPI, despite elevated December FOMC hike odds.
